title: sindhinorm: a corpus-guided, native-validated spelling normalizer for Sindhi
description:
sindhinorm normalizes Sindhi text typed on mixed Urdu, Persian and Arabic keyboards. It decides per word, using word frequencies from Sindhi Wikipedia, and never merges spelling pairs that a native Sindhi speaker judged to be different words. It restores 94.0% of words altered by Urdu-keyboard typing on the UD Sindhi test set and changes 1.35% of clean words.

Install: pip install sindhinorm. Code: MIT. Bundled word list: CC BY-SA 4.0 (derived from Sindhi Wikipedia). Part of MorphoTok-SD-UR, a preregistered study of morphology-aware tokenization for Sindhi and Urdu.
